ablation.name: d8c_heads8_gate05_15ep
ablation.notes: D8c: Combined width scaling + stronger style gate. style_attn_num_heads 4->8, style_cross_attn_gate_init 0.3->0.5. Theory: D8a only adds heads but keeps gate=0.3 (conservative style injection). D8c tests if stronger gate + more heads together can break the 0.476 ceiling. The gate controls how much cross-attention style delta is applied; 0.5 vs 0.3 = 67% stronger style signal. If D8a shows micro-gain, D8c tests scaling. If D8a fails, D8c tests if gate strength is the bottleneck. bs=96.
